{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    H=rng.randint(7,12); W=rng.randint(9,15)
    g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    c1=rng.randint(1,W-5); r1=rng.randint(1,H-4)
    hh=rng.randint(1,3); ww=rng.randint(1,3)
    col1=rng.choice([1,3,4,6,8,9])
    for r in range(r1,min(H,r1+hh)):
        for c in range(c1,min(W,c1+ww)): g[r][c]=col1
    # second object to the right, with a one-cell gap, irregular polyomino
    c2=min(W-2,c1+ww+rng.randint(2,4)); r2=max(0,min(H-3,r1+rng.randint(-1,2)))
    col2=rng.choice([2,5,7])
    cells=[(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)]
    if rng.random()<.6: cells.append((2,1))
    for dr,dc in cells:
        if r2+dr<H and c2+dc<W: g[r2+dr][c2+dc]=col2
    return g"}
